canonical_project: North Karelia distributed data center network / KY Data Center Nadvoitsy
owner: Petrozavodsk State University; GS Nanotech; KY Data Center
notes: 2019-2020 reports said PetrSU and GS Nanotech planned a 10 billion ruble distributed data-center network in Karelia, including a central node in Petrozavodsk and northern facilities; TASS reported investor KY Data Center had already invested 520 million rubles at the Rusal aluminum plant site in Nadvoitsy. No recent completion evidence found, so status is unknown.
